changes: Reconciliation uses the open book, one stable account picker, monthly completion filtering, and version-checked editing of saved records.
Reports include compact summaries and ledger details, with account/date selection and up to three signatories in one export dialog.
Bank date controls stay inline with clear explanations; duplicate working labels and the misplaced Funds shortcut are removed.
Previously published first-day amortization, separate AMO IDs and Active Journal ordering are preserved.
